references.text: The fulfillment of the promise: Aaron's staff budded, blossomed, and produced almonds, confirming God's choice
God declares that he will show who belongs to him and whom he has chosen
Aaron's staff was to be kept as a sign against rebels to stop their complaints
The complaints of the Israelites against Aaron and his priesthood
The people's grumbling was actually directed at the Lord, not just at Moses and Aaron
The psalm mentions the rebellion against Moses and Aaron, the Lord's holy ones, in the camp
Aaron's staff that budded is mentioned as part of the ark of the covenant and a witness to God's choice
God chooses his servants so that people will know and believe in him
